title: Edifier Black Friday deals 2026 UK: headphones, earbuds and speakers
seoTitle: Edifier Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Up to 57% Off on Amazon
description: Edifier's Black Friday 2026 UK prices on Amazon: WH950NB headphones £79.99, NeoBuds Planar £89.99, G1000 II speakers £29.99, studio monitors and more, 19–30 November.
intro:
**Short answer: the Edifier WH950NB noise-cancelling headphones at £79.99 and the G1000 II desktop speakers at £29.99 are the standout Edifier Black Friday deals in the UK. Both are more than half off Edifier's list price on Amazon.**

Edifier's UK Black Friday sale runs on Amazon from 19 to 30 November 2026. The prices below are Edifier's sale prices for that period, from the brand's own UK deal list, and we checked every one against Amazon's live price on 20 November. Amazon prices can change during the sale, so check the price on the product page before you buy.
body:
## The best Edifier deals by type

- **Noise-cancelling headphones:** WH950NB (2025) £79.99, ES850NB £69.99.
- **Earbuds:** NeoBuds Planar £89.99, NeoBuds Plus £69.99.
- **Cheap desktop speakers:** G1000 II £29.99, R20BT £32.99.
- **Gaming:** G2000 Pro speakers £89.99, G5 MAX gaming headphones £109.99.
- **Home studio:** MR5 monitors £189.99, MR4.5 £159.99.
- **Living room and hi-fi:** R2750DB MKII £269.99, M90 £219.99, S880DB MKII from £229.99, A60 £269.99, T5s subwoofer £109.99, S5 subwoofer £296.99.

## Are Edifier's Black Friday prices any good?

The discounts are worked out from Edifier's own list prices, which aren't always what the speakers sell for day to day. Judged against rivals instead, they still look good: WH950NB headphones under £80 and NeoBuds Planar under £90 cost far less than big-name models with similar features.

If you're choosing between Edifier and a big name: the WH950NB is the budget alternative to Sony's WH-1000XM range. The NeoBuds are worth a look if you use Android, where AirPods lose most of their extras.

## Which Edifier speakers should you buy?

- **For a laptop or PC desk:** the G1000 II at £29.99 is the no-brainer. Spend more on the M60 (£109.99) or QR65 (£199.99) if you want better sound and looks. The QR65 can also charge your phone or laptop.
- **For gaming:** the G2000 Pro at £89.99.
- **For music making:** the MR5 at £189.99. It's only £30 more than the smaller MR4.5, which has a smaller discount.
- **For a living room or record player:** the R2750DB MKII at £269.99, with the T5s subwoofer at £109.99 if you want more bass.

## More Black Friday deals

See our [Black Friday 2026 live deals](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/), updated three times a day. Or read our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) for Amazon's key dates and Prime tips.

deals.name: Edifier WH950NB noise-cancelling headphones (2025)
deals.note: Edifier's flagship over-ear noise-cancelling headphones for £79.99, the biggest cut in its UK sale (about 56% off its list price). The one to get if you want Sony-style features for well under £100. Also in off-white.

deals.name: Edifier ES850NB noise-cancelling headphones
deals.note: Over-ear noise-cancelling headphones for £69.99, less than half Edifier's list price. Comes in black, pearl white, misty pink and earth brown, all the same price.

deals.name: Edifier NeoBuds Planar earbuds
deals.note: Wireless earbuds with planar magnetic drivers, which are usually found in far pricier hi-fi headphones. 55% off Edifier's list price.

deals.name: Edifier NeoBuds Plus earbuds
deals.note: Edifier's noise-cancelling earbuds for under £70. A cheaper alternative to AirPods Pro 3 (£200) if you're not on an iPhone or don't need Apple's extras.

deals.name: Edifier G1000 II desktop speakers
deals.note: The cheapest pair in the sale: compact desktop speakers with Bluetooth and RGB lighting for £29.99, 57% off. A big step up from laptop or monitor speakers. Black or white.

deals.name: Edifier R20BT speakers
deals.note: USB-powered Bluetooth desktop speakers for £32.99, 45% off. Good for a bedroom, kitchen or a student's desk.

deals.name: Edifier G2000 Pro gaming speakers
deals.note: Edifier's gaming desktop speakers for £89.99, 40% off. Black is £89.99 and white is £88.99.

deals.name: Edifier M60 desktop speakers
deals.note: Small, premium-looking desktop speakers that suit a home office or a gaming setup. £50 off.

deals.name: Edifier MP330 portable speaker
deals.note: A retro-styled portable Bluetooth speaker. The woodgrain version is the cheapest at £69.99; black and white are £79.99.

deals.name: Edifier QR65 desktop speakers
deals.note: Desktop speakers with a built-in fast charger for your phone or laptop, and lighting. £130 off, about 39%.

deals.name: Edifier MR5 studio monitor speakers
deals.note: Edifier's MR studio monitors are a popular first pair for music making and home studios. £90 off; white is £188.99.

deals.name: Edifier MR4.5 studio monitor speakers
deals.note: The newer, smaller MR monitors. Only 20% off, so the MR5 at £30 more is the better deal if you have the space.

deals.name: Edifier M90 speakers
deals.note: A step up for desks and small rooms, £80 off. Satin black or silk white.

deals.name: Edifier R2750DB MKII bookshelf speakers
deals.note: Larger powered bookshelf speakers for a living room or TV. £80 off in black walnut.

deals.name: Edifier T5s subwoofer
deals.note: A powered subwoofer to add bass to a desktop or bookshelf pair. £40 off, in black or walnut.
